name: The Lost Report
summary: Sifting through loose dirt in Dustwallow Marsh, you find an orc's severed hand clutching a tube carved from bone, with a dirt-stained parchment inside. It is a report written by an orc who watched Theramore as a spy for weeks, and it is meant for Nazeer Bloodpike, the orcs' spymaster at Brackenwall Village.

sections.title: A Hand in the Dirt
sections.body: In the loose dirt lies an orc's severed hand, gripping a tube carved from bone. The parchment inside is a report from an orc who watched Theramore as a spy for weeks. After scanning it, you see that it should go to Nazeer Bloodpike, the orcs' spymaster at Brackenwall Village.

sections.title: Word from the Spymaster
sections.body: Nazeer Bloodpike says the author was Marg Nighteye, an agent stationed outside Theramore to keep watch on the city. This is Marg's latest report and perhaps the last: from what you tell, Bloodpike fears Marg met an end in the swamp.

aliases: how to start the lost report
faq.answer: It lies in loose dirt in Dustwallow Marsh, in the grip of a severed orc hand.

aliases: what does the spy report say
faq.answer: An orc wrote it after weeks of spying on Theramore.

aliases: who do i turn the report in to
faq.answer: The orcs' spymaster, Nazeer Bloodpike, at Brackenwall Village.
